comment: He's really not that bad. He is SUPER passionate about American History, and you need to be to enjoy class. That whole essay structure thing is actually helpful, and makes you really edit your work. There were only two papers (6 & 12 pg) the entire year, so work was minimal. You have to do the reading if you want to have ANYTHING to say in class.

Pagan's ratings prior to this were extremely distorted. While his class does require reading and he is picky about the format of the essays, he demonstrates in encyclopedic knowledge of early American History and clearly contextualizes the issues that crafted the Constitution. I learned a lot, and he reaffirmed my interest in law.

Pagan is a good FYS teacher. Class was engaging and discussion was relaxed. There was a decent amount of reading but no reading tests and if you skip a couple of the readings, it's no big deal. Papers are difficult; Pagan's a stickler for grammar so get your paper edited by someone. In-class debate was fun and raised everyone's grade. Awesome guy.
Pagan is an interesting guy. I loved his class, and if you like early American history i would recommend it. That being said it is very hard I did okay in it but I would still highly recommend it.

On your first paper you start with a terrible grade regardless of whether you are a good writer or not. then it slowly goes up each paper as if youve miraculously become the next Melville. he knows his stuff almost too well for his own good. if you dont own a strunk and white, memorize it because that is his holy bible.

Pagan is a ridiculously unrealistic professor. He assigns massive readings for homework, and most of it is rather cryptic. His papers follow an inane format, 11 lines per paragraph and 2 paragraphs per page, which make writing his papers impossible; on top of his emphasis on format rather than content, his grading is harsh. DO NOT take his class.

I was not interested in taking his class at all before..in fact, it was the only FYS available to take; but, I REALLY enjoy his class. His discussion are really relaxed and he's very nice. He expects hard work out of his students but doesnt grade extremely hard There is a lot of reading but it's not too bad. I would definitely recommend this class!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! Pagan is an extremely judgmental grader.  You work your butt off just for a C.  If you do not follow his strict guidelines for the 3 papers (11 sentences per paragraph exactly) you will fail. His expectations for the papers are unrealistic and this class wasn't worth the stress or the effort I put into it

he was extremely rude to students on several ocassions. He grades as though he is an English professor and has extremely odd requirements for papers. Discusses the textbooks like he is an English teacher and goes off on tangents during class discussions with some frequency. dont take him unless you LOVE history and LOVE working like crazy.

Please disregard every other comment. Pagan is absolutely amazing!! Not only is he an interesting, intelligent man, but his class demands so much of students. I am an English major now as a direct result of his CORE class. If you get this msn for CORE consider yourself lucky! It is going to be a great experience

He's a smart guy, used to be the dean of the law school or something... but he's old and outdated- uses a grammar book from the 70's and grades papers very difficultly. You can get away with not reading to participate in class, but dont' expect to do well on the papers if you didn''t read, unless you are a supreme bs-er of course

This guy is terrible. He missed class one day and asked why no one called him to see where he was. Accordingly, he added an extra class to the schedule. Pray to the big man in the sky that you do not get Pagan for CORE, or else you will suffer just as I am right now. If you get Pagan, have mercy on your blessed soul, you are done for.

Pagan is a very intelligent man, however he is incredibly closed minded! He has a lot of interesting points but doesn't promote discussion. He turned Core into a lecture class which sucks... The entire grade is 4 papers and participation, which he doesn't facilitate. Avoid him if you can. Oh PS his grammar rules are wrong but do it.

If you recieve this man for CORE, your life is over as you know it.  He is very arrogant, and will not help you unless you kiss his butt.  His grading is unfair, and his grammar rules come from a book last published in 1975.  So your life is over as you know it if you get him.  He grades like a law class, which its not.  Your opinion is wrong w/him
He is arrogant  He grades like it is a law course.  You learn absolutely nothing about colonial history. The course has no structure.  There is a toon of reading, but it doesn't matter if you do it.
